6 Hours Private Tour Proposal

Hidden Gems of Lake Como

1 June 2026Como

An elegant day on the water

A 6-hour private experience that pairs effortless cruising on Lake Como with a relaxing stop for lunch at the Grand Hotel Tremezzo. You will glide past the lake's most iconic villas — from Villa d'Este to George Clooney's and the Hollywood villas of Gucci, Star Wars and Casino Royale — before discovering hidden waterfalls and timeless lakeside towns. Departure from Como with a chilled Prosecco aperitivo on board.

01 Tour Highlight

Villa Pliniana

A historic 16th-century villa on Lake Como, in Torno. A scenic waterfall runs through the property, creating a dramatic natural feature behind the villa.

02 Tour Highlight

Villa La Cassinella

A luxurious private villa on the shores of Lake Como, known for its stunning views and exclusive, secluded setting. Accessible only by boat, it is one of the most prestigious and private residences in the region.

03 Tour Highlight

Villa del Balbianello

Disembark at the exclusive FAI dock for a self-guided walk through the lush terraced gardens of one of the most photographed landmarks on the lake, featured in Star Wars and James Bond films.

04 Stop & Explore

Bellagio

Step ashore for a gelato stop in the charming cobbled streets of Bellagio, often referred to as the pearl of Lake Como.

05 Tour Highlight

Orrido di Nesso

A breathtaking natural gorge where a powerful waterfall flows through the village of Nesso, passing under a picturesque medieval stone bridge — one of the most photogenic hidden gems of the lake, best admired from the water.

06 Stop & Explore

Varenna

Disembark and wander the romantic lanes of Varenna, enjoying a gelato in one of the most enchanting villages on the eastern shore.

The Boat

Gozzo Sorrentino

A traditional Italian wooden boat, common along the Mediterranean coasts. Stable and elegant in its simplicity, it is the authentic way to enjoy the lake — calm, intimate and timeless.
